nodes.label: Twilight Sanctuary Design Language
nodes.rationale: Calm, atmospheric, handcrafted aesthetic blending Cupertino precision with warm nighttime nature; rejects generic SaaS styling, uses glass/glow/moonlit-amber tokens, and treats aesthetic integrity as equal to functional correctness.

nodes.label: Optimistic UI Contract
nodes.rationale: Mutations affecting visible surfaces must cancel in-flight queries, snapshot cache, update optimistically, rollback on error, and invalidate on settle; perceived instant speed is the defining UX attribute of a productivity tool.

nodes.label: TanStack Query for Server State
nodes.rationale: All server data flows through TanStack Query with centralized query keys and differentiated STALE_TIMES; never fetch backend state via useEffect + local component state.

nodes.label: Typed Hono RPC Client
nodes.rationale: All API calls flow through hc<AppType> from @cadence/backend; no raw fetch for app API calls so route contracts are compile-time safe.

nodes.label: Radix Primitives Wrapper Layer
nodes.rationale: Radix primitives are consumed only through app/components/primitives/ wrappers, never imported directly into domain components, to keep one consistent styled control system.

nodes.label: app.css Design Token Source of Truth
nodes.rationale: All foundational visual tokens live in app/app.css under @theme/:root; components use semantic twilight/lantern/moonlit tokens with a contrast floor, never one-off hardcoded hex.

nodes.label: Fractional Indexing for Ordering
nodes.rationale: Task/subtask order uses fractional indices via computeNextOrderIndex/computeMidpointIndex so reordering never renumbers whole lists.

nodes.label: Client-Side Notification Center
nodes.rationale: Notification derivation is client-side only; reminder-engine.ts scans cached tasks/habits on a 60s interval and useSyncExternalStore holds session-scoped dismiss/read state that resets on reload by design.

nodes.label: MainLayout Shared App Shell
nodes.rationale: MainLayout is the primary frame for authenticated routes, mounting sidebar, command palette, quick-add, notification center, settings dialog, toaster, and holding panel so new routes compose through it.

nodes.label: Zustand Local UI State Stores
nodes.rationale: Local cross-component UI state (sidebar, tag filter, task selection, right panel, task completion) lives in Zustand stores, separated by type from server state and local device cache.
